blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than 30 teams from Cebu and other parts of the country are set to compete in the 3rd Cor Jesu Invitational Volleyball Tournament on November 7 and 8 at the Sacred Heart School-Ateneo de Cebu campus in Mandaue City. The two-day tournament will feature girls’ divisions for Under-10, Under-12, and Under-15, providing young volleyball players an opportunity to compete against teams from different parts of the Philippines. Among the participating teams are Bacolod Taytung, Davao Christian High School, Kong Hua School Cagayan de Oro, and squads representing Zhake Tabuelan, Dalaguete, Compostela, Catmon Palaro, Tuburan, Lapu-Lapu, Mandaue […]...
